articles.title: Blame bitcoin's tumble on rising inflation, not Strategy, 10xResearch argues
articles.snippet: The main driver behind bitcoin's weakness was ETF selling after red-hot April U.S. inflation data, 10x's Markus Thielen argued. The bounce may hinge on Wednesday's CPI data, he said.

articles.title: MetaMask launches AI agent wallet with built-in security for crypto trades
articles.snippet: The launch comes as AI agents increasingly emerge as participants in crypto markets, executing trades and managing capital on behalf of users.

articles.title: Bitmine bought the dip, making its biggest ether purchase in 2026 as prices tanked
articles.snippet: The company bought 126,971 ETH last week, worth roughly $214 million at current prices, despite chairman Tom Lee's earlier calls to slow purchases.

articles.title: Crypto's recovery remains elusive as SpaceX, Anthropic IPOs loom
Bitcoin spikes, then dumps, from $63,700 as analysts assess Strategy's next BTC moves
articles.snippet: BTC, ETH, XRP and others pulled back from their overnight highs as Iran-Israel tensions and oil rally triggered risk aversion in Asian stocks.
